notes.title: Update Information (2017/07/21)
notes.content:
Update ver. 1.0.1.0 released.

Corrected an issue in which, at castle towns, NPCs were sometimes positioned such that it was impossible for the player character to talk to them.

notes.title: "Exclusive Costumes" available for limited time
notes.content:
For early purchasers of the game, the "Exclusive Costumes" will be available for four weeks from PM of May 23rd (Pacific time).
You can find the free DLC called "Exclusive Costumes" and download it for free.
This offer is limited time only.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28416110/4ced8826fc8676c190b874463f35cdf9f28aac2b.jpg[/img]
The "Exclusive Costumes" contains below costumes.
- SW: Spirit of Sanada - "Kunoichi" Sanada Colors Costume
- SW: Spirit of Sanada - "Ina" Sanada Colors Costume
- SW: Spirit of Sanada - "Kai" Sanada Colors Costume
- SW: Spirit of Sanada - "Kunoichi" Special Costume
- SW: Spirit of Sanada - "Chacha" Sanada Colors Costume

tags.feature: You can find the free DLC called "Exclusive Costumes" and download it for free.
